headline: Russian media portray 'transparent' elections at home and chaos in Europe
description: As expected, Vladimir Putin's United Russia party secured another two-thirds majority in the Duma. Russian television and newspapers presented the result as a foregone conclusion, reinforcing an image of normalcy and maintaining a confrontational atmosphere with Europe.

headline: Inside the Hamidovic clan's reign of terror over young female pickpockets in the Paris métro
description: They name their children Dior or Al Capone and love designer clothes and luxury cars. To maintain their lavish lifestyle, the men of the Hamidovic clan – a Romani family of Bosnian origin – have maintained a reign of fear over an army of young female pickpockets on Paris public transportation. One branch of the network is on trial in Paris from September 15 to 23.

headline: Emma Heming Willis on her husband Bruce Willis's illness: 'Once I stopped being in denial, we've learned to just navigate the disease'
description: The actor learned he was suffering from a neurodegenerative disease at 67. Close to four years after the diagnosis, his wife describes how she coped with the illness and her new role as a caregiver.
